Version 16, the page alone (no file beside it changed). New: flux in the Cell view, stage 4 of the quantity layers: a Flux switch in the legend, off as the page opens; a part's flux shows when the visitor chooses the part, and the switch shows all of it; beads with bloom, the look's own motion held still while they show. A part named in the page's address shows no flux as the page opens. At rest the cell's water drops, signals and close-up ions now stand still: they moved with a direction and had no rate behind them. Also new: the legend no longer lies over the view's card in a short window (it scrolls within the room left under the card); on a replay the statement starts clear of the legend when a panel is open, and the beads keep true time whatever the gap between frames. Built from a clean copy of ae914a2a. Real-click checks there, one run each, all passed: input 55 of 55; species 62 of 62; shelves Syn3A 17, planarian 18, without files 6, human 25, E. coli 5, and thale cress's nine shelves 5 of 5; layers zero 7, the switch 14, the close-up 19, flow 22, the example 8; the look 21, its switch 19 (with the stand-in font, where it had missed before the legend's fix), the other views 12; flux in the Cell view 26 of 26 in light, dark, at 1040 by 640, moving, on thale cress and on E. coli, 24 of 24 on a phone, and the address 5 of 5; the Cell view's part on E. coli 12 of 12, with a real press on the door from a flagellum's foot into the Protein atlas (its flagellum's proteins picked out), and on thale cress 11 of 11. New: the nucleus, the Golgi apparatus and the ribosomes are parts of the map of their own, planned and illustration only, by the user's decision of 16 November 2026 (docs/CELL_STRUCTURES.md): nothing of them is in the engine and each panel says so; 'Regulatory circuits' is drawn at the cell's DNA, and 'Membrane trafficking' at the vesicles; where colour shows the kind of part every part is drawn whole, and 'Colour: Status' shows what is not built as grey sketches; a structure the cell does not hold is read from the species' file, and a structure has a door into the Protein atlas where the species' own proteins can show its set.
